about: BN4's HeatShot B (its chip 19) against the registry's row for it (id 588), its family 0x1E moved as an attack unit (BN6's grown attack family 0xD0; docs/multirom/bn4-chips.md): each picked on the first Custom screen and used at fight frame 88 against BN4's MettaurSP (140 HP) at (5,2), whose wave strikes MegaMan at t97, his arm out and his shot not yet made: his struck state ends the attack in both, the arm let go as its slot is cleared (his object's +0x4C), no shot, 1880 HP. From t120, as the struck state ends, BN4's flags keep the attack's 0x400000 and BN6's do not (legit.json's bn4 interrupted_attack).
